title: LINUXDRV-004: `relay_mutex` and `port_mutex` are initialized but never destroyed before the private data is freed
description:
LINUXDRV-004: `relay_mutex` and `port_mutex` are initialized but never destroyed before the private data is freed. This is unlikely to affect a single-process normal shutdown, but repeated driver load/unload cycles leak pthread mutex resources and complicate sanitizers. Destroy both mutexes during detach/delete after timers are cancelled and no callbacks can use them. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied. Current audit reconciliation: Current generated GPIO drivers no longer own historical relay_mutex/port_mutex members. Next: capture removed-ownership and current lifecycle checks for verified historical closure; not silently closed by this audit.
